walkthroughs.name: Why voice is its own thread

beats.heading: Two threads, two jobs
beats.body: The coordinator is a separate thread with its own model and settings. It answers, investigates a little, and hands anything sustained to the workhorse, which goes on working while it talks.

beats.heading: The tools are frozen, and checked
beats.body: What the coordinator may ask for is a manifest pinned by digest, and every call is validated against it before it runs. A call that has already run is not run again.

beats.heading: Archboard brokers, it does not speak
beats.body: The tab makes the peer connection and carries the audio. Archboard passes the offer to the child and the answer back, and never holds a voice endpoint of its own.

beats.heading: An approval is answered once
beats.body: A spoken answer arms a gate on one approval. Whether it is then answered out loud or in the pane, it settles exactly once, and an unproven answer falls back to the narrowest outcome.
